	<ResortReportHeadline>It's wet and wild at Hotham!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>Well, I wish I left this one for Bill. Thankfully the showers stayed away longer than expected yesterday however they intensified in the early evening and persisted through the night.</p><p>The current temp is +3.4 which is already slightly above our forecast max of +3 degrees. There's a damp fog in the Village and while there's no precipitation right at this moment there are more showers forecast throughout the day. The wind is still strong from NNW so again keep an eye on the App and the lift report for live updates as some lifts may be hampered.</p><p>With the showers and warm overnight temps the snow will be soft and very forgiving from the outset today. The open groomed terrain will be the best bet on a very user friendly surface. In more positive news this unwelcome weather looks set to ease tomorrow and should continue to improve into the weekend.</p><p>It'll be a day for low light lenses and your best Gore-Tex. Cheers, Burner.</p></ResortReport>
